insert.foreach: MERGE INTO room r USING (SELECT #{room.roomNumber} as room_number FROM dual) s ON (r.room_number = s.room_number) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, room_number, room_type_id, floor, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (ROOM_SEQ.nextval, #{room.roomNumber}, #{room.roomTypeId}, #{room.floor}, #{room.status}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)

mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.room_number as roomNumber, r.room_type_id as roomTypeId, rt.type_name as roomTypeName, r.floor, r.status FROM room r LEFT JOIN room_type rt ON r.room_type_id = rt.id WHERE r.id = #{roomId}

SELECT ci.guest_name as guestName, ci.guest_phone as guestPhone, ci.guest_id_card as guestIdCard, ci.check_in_time as checkInTime, ci.check_out_date as checkOutDate FROM check_in_record ci WHERE ci.room_id = #{roomId} AND ci.status = 0 AND ci.check_out_time IS NULL AND ROWNUM = 1 ORDER BY ci.check_in_time DESC
